goal: Propagate corrected Shadow Dweller convergence ladder and Vol 3 SDX victory
body: CANON CORRECTION PACKAGE, 2026-09-05. Preserve these together: (1) Vol. 1 X1/Prime Xoah dies through unwilling convergence into the X² continuation. (2) Vol. 3 SDX/X99 defeats X², wins the mirror confrontation, and imprisons X² in the Veil. The trilogy does NOT close cleanly. (3) X² spends an eons-scale subjective exile traveling through Veil time/history before reappearing in Vol. 4. (4) Post-Vol. 3 architecture splits into two mirror journeys: public long-form Shadow Dweller: Xoah anime following SDX/X99's 1000+ episode origin, and hidden/parallel X² Veil exile. (5) Vol. 4 returns X²; Shadow King maims SDX; SDX voluntarily sacrifices herself into X² convergence. This mirrors Vol. 1: forced convergence becomes chosen convergence, violation/death becomes agency/redemption/gift. Anchors: 22509@db6, 22510@db6, 27173@db4, 22638@db8, 22639@db8. Existing release-order shard 22430@db3 amended with the correction.

Informational lore record, no action required.
